rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, that's a generous offer and the timing is good. The concrete project we're starting is a structured, sourced dataset of the public safety commitments frontier AI developers have made (pre-deployment evals, incident reporting, security, third-party access), with evidence on whether each one has been kept. The most useful first step for your ~5 hours a week would be a quick landscape check over the next week or two: which trackers or datasets like this already exist, what they cover, how often they're updated, and where the gaps are. I don't want us duplicating someone else's work. A short list with links and a sentence or two on each would be perfect. After that I'd love your input on the schema and on how to set up independent double-coding so the dataset holds up. For now we're keeping this low-profile, nothing public yet, so please treat it as work in progress. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: I replied to her offer and asked her to do that check (a list of existing trackers and their gaps). I told her to keep it low-profile for now.
